column31: AsparaGlue develops innovative medical adhesives and sealants to address unmet clinical needs in external wound closure and internal tissue adhesion.
column32: Medical superglues are widely employed for external wound closure, however high toxicity and poor degradation have prevented their widespread use for internal clinical procedures. We have developed a novel superglue-like tissue adhesive (AsparaGlue) that is derived from natural non-toxic monomers. Applied as a spray, liquid, or patch, AsparaGlue polymerizes rapidly upon contact with a wet tissue surface, forming a strong bond within seconds. AsparaGlue has the attractive features of a medical superglue (rapid curing and high mechanical strength) combined with excellent biocompatibility and degradability. AsparaGlue can be used for both external wound closure and internal tissue adhesion and sealing, making it unlike any other superglue on the market.
